parsed.explanation: The parent regime imposes universal, traveller-facing exposures: passports must reflect birth-assigned sex, X markers barred, visa officers instructed to refuse on 'reasonable doubt' about sex with possible lifetime fraud findings, documented strandings/detentions of foreign trans travellers, and allied governments issuing advisories — tier-1 style measures touching every trans visitor. State-level layered onto that: this state/province has K-12 facility bans, a 2023 executive order defining sex by birth for all state facilities including shelters, rape-crisis centres and incarceration, no gender-identity discrimination protections, minimal local recourse, and a hostile social climate (Nex Benedict case, death threats). Mitigants: facility bans are mostly government/school-scoped, the criminal trespass trigger requires willful entry plus refusal, national hate-crime statute and employment ruling persist, no state-specific visitor violence documented, and private-sector care/protections exist in one city. Per rule 12 derivation, this sits at the parent's exposure plus additional local restrictions and hostility, marginally below the parent's own level: ~0.42.
